IRON BISGLYCINATE · CAPSULES

Elemental iron per serving

The amount of iron itself, stated separately from the weight of the bisglycinate compound.

Iron bisglycinate is iron bound to the amino acid glycine. As with any iron compound, the key number is how much iron itself a serving provides.
